rules: All product showcases and non-vertical tools live on a-11-oy.com.
Hugging Face Spaces are reserved for one flagship demo per business vertical.
Models, datasets and collections may remain on Hugging Face independent of the Space policy.
A legacy Space is eligible for deletion only after unique source, product copy, and evidence references are captured in GitHub and the product front door.
GitHub remains canonical source; Hugging Face is a deployment and discovery surface.
delete_strategy: export-or-map -> verify front-door capture -> verify source ownership -> delete legacy Space
